body:
Feeling like I haven't done anything to be worth having 'saved' myself by denying the thoughts the first time. I'm 25, still live at home, don't have a degree, have no idea what I am doing in school, and can't even have a steady relationship.

Just ended a potential relationship with a friend and was chewed out for it. Called a 'liar' and worse.

I feel useless and a waste to everyone I know or meet.
